description: Defines classes and functions for profiling memory allocations, including AllocationPlan, AllocationPlanner, CPUProfilingAllocator, and related guard classes, used for tracking and managing memory allocations in a profiling context within the c10 namespace.

classes.name: AllocationPlan
classes.description: Records memory allocation sizes, lifetimes, offsets, and total size for profiling purposes.

classes.name: AllocationPlanner
classes.description: Maps memory pointers to allocation IDs and manages allocation lifetime validation.

classes.name: CPUProfilingAllocator
classes.description: Manages memory allocations based on an AllocationPlan, used for profiling allocations.

classes.name: WithProfileAllocationsGuard
classes.description: Context manager for profiling allocations during a code block.

classes.name: WithValidateAllocationPlanGuard
classes.description: Context manager for validating an allocation plan during a code block.

classes.name: WithProfilingAllocatorGuard
classes.description: Context manager for temporarily setting a profiling allocator with a plan.

methods.name: validate_allocation
methods.description: Validates an allocation's size and pointer.

methods.name: record_allocation
methods.description: Records a new memory allocation with size and pointer.

methods.name: record_free
methods.description: Records freeing of a memory pointer.

methods.name: formulate_plan
methods.description: Generates an allocation plan based on recorded allocations.

methods.name: set_plan
methods.description: Sets the allocation plan for the allocator.

methods.name: WithProfileAllocationsGuard
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for profiling scope.

methods.name: WithValidateAllocationPlanGuard
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for validation scope.

methods.name: WithProfilingAllocatorGuard
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for temporary allocator setup.
